name: RFP and RFI response
oneliner: The whole machine for answering a formal RFP or RFI, from requirement extraction to submission day.
metaTitle: RFP and RFI response support | Techno War Room
metaDescription: We run the full RFP response for must-win deals: requirement extraction, compliance matrix, response architecture, drafting, reviews, and submission readiness.

scenarios.title: The big one just landed
scenarios.text: Three hundred questions, a three week clock, and a portal that punishes formatting mistakes. The team that has to answer it is already at capacity.

scenarios.title: Losing on technicalities
scenarios.text: Your solution is strong but responses keep getting marked down for missed requirements, thin answers, and compliance gaps nobody caught before submission.

scenarios.title: The blank page problem
scenarios.text: Each RFP starts from zero because the last response lives in somebody's inbox. The same answers get rewritten worse, under more pressure.

what: We run the full response to a formal RFP or RFI. We extract every requirement into a register, build the compliance matrix, design the response architecture, draft the answers, coordinate your reviewers, and get the package submission ready.
You stay accountable for the solution and the relationship. We carry the document, the process, and the deadline.

deliverables.name: Requirement register and compliance matrix
deliverables.desc: Every requirement extracted, tracked, and mapped to an answer and its evidence.

deliverables.name: Response architecture
deliverables.desc: The outline, win themes, and answer ownership plan agreed before drafting starts.

deliverables.name: Drafted response
deliverables.desc: The full written response in your template and your voice, ready for your review.

deliverables.name: Review tracker
deliverables.desc: Who reviews what, by when, with every comment resolved or explicitly parked.

deliverables.name: Submission pack
deliverables.desc: Final compliance check, formatting pass, and the assembled package for the portal or the inbox.

steps.title: Bring the deal
steps.text: We read the RFP and tell you within a day whether we can make the date and what it will take.

steps.title: Extract
steps.text: Every requirement goes into the register and the compliance matrix. Nothing gets answered until everything is counted.
steps.need: One hour with the deal owner

steps.title: Architect
steps.text: We agree the outline, the win themes, and who owns each answer before a single word is drafted.

steps.title: Draft and review
steps.text: We write, you correct facts and sharpen claims. The review tracker keeps the loop honest.

steps.title: Submit
steps.text: Final compliance check against the matrix, formatting pass, packaging, and a submission-day checklist.

excludes: We do not invent your solution. Your architects decide what you are selling.
We do not set your price. That is Pricing and SOW construction, a separate service.
We do not speak to your buyer. The buyer only ever sees your firm.
We do not fabricate answers. If a requirement cannot honestly be met, the matrix says so and we write the mitigation.

shape.v: Two to six weeks, matched to the RFP clock
Retained, for teams with steady RFP flow

domains.name: B2B SaaS
domains.note: Mid-market SaaS RFPs lean on questionnaires and integration detail. The matrix keeps the long tail honest.

domains.name: IT services
domains.note: Services RFPs score method, team, and transition. The response architecture carries more narrative weight.

domains.name: BFSI
domains.note: Compliance annexes and regulatory questions expand the matrix. Precision beats prose.

domains.name: Healthcare
domains.note: Expect clinical, privacy, and interoperability sections that need SME time booked early.

related.name: Proposal deck building
related.desc: The narrative and the artefact for the presented stage of the pursuit.
related.boundary: The RFP is the written answer. The deck is the room performance. One narrative, two artefacts.

related.name: Pricing and SOW construction
related.desc: The commercial structure the response commits you to.

related.name: Security questionnaires and vendor assessments
related.desc: The parallel workstream that usually arrives mid-response.
